answer: Customers have 30 calendar days to return unused products [returns-policy-50d37f04-1]

citations.title: Returns and refunds
citations.quote: Northstar Retail accepts unused products within 30 calendar days of delivery.
citations.content: Northstar Retail accepts unused products within 30 calendar days of delivery. Customers must provide an order ID and proof of purchase. Refunds go to the original payment method within 7 business days after the returned item passes inspection. Personalized items cannot be returned unless they arrive damaged. This is a fictional demonstration policy.
